works.title: Spiritual Practice for Skeptics
works.description: A book on spiritual practice designed for the Western mind, specifically for reductionists and atheists who dismiss spiritual concepts as woo woo. The user has extensive documentation across multiple conversations and is planning to expand it into a full book with full prose overview.
works.quote: I went into considerable detail across several threads about a book on spiritual practice designed for the Western mind—specifically for reductionists and even those who consider themselves completely atheistic and dismiss anything with the word "spiritual" as woo woo nonsense.

works.title: Learning Methodology Framework
works.description: A framework for determining what to learn and the optimal approach for each subject. Based on a repeated methodology the user has applied across various subjects, including the development of the Ora system itself. User has preliminary documentation and plans to expand it into a book.
works.quote: I need a framework for figuring out what you want to learn and the best way to approach it, because there is a methodology—one I've repeated across a wide variety of subjects, several of which were required just to develop the ORA system itself.

works.title: Temporal Processing Theory and Embodied Rhythm Scaffolding
works.description: A neurocognitive theory explaining specific autism manifestations through temporal processing deficits. The theory proposes that individuals with this manifestation do not receive proper temporal signals and must learn temporal sequencing as a higher-order function, which cascades into multiple behavioral and cognitive challenges. Based on observation and grounded in neuroscience literature.
works.quote: I'm developing a theory that he has a problem with temporal processing in the brain—that he's not getting the proper signals to construct time and is having to learn it as a higher-order function, which delays everything and creates all kinds of problems.

works.title: Prompt Engineering Methodology
works.description: A structured methodology for writing effective prompts for AI based on classical writing principles from Elements of Style and Style: Lessons in Clarity and Grace. Includes systematic rules for term definition, actor naming, grammatical control, constraint specification, and emphasis on clarity principles derived from traditional writing craft.
works.quote: Can you consult the principles from these books or other books on writing with clarity to help specify how to clean up prompts for AI?

works.title: Marriage Failure and Reflection Essay
works.description: A personal essay reflecting on marriage failure, personal responsibility, emotional growth, and the journey toward self-awareness. Explores the user's missteps in marriage, failure to meet partner's needs with grace, and the process of releasing anger and embracing compassion as foundation for understanding.
works.quote: It's a story that stretches over years—a story of missteps. Wrong ideas seeded wrong choices. The choices grew into actions, careless and sharp, and those actions mattered.
